observations_to_uint8_rgb: convert a simulator scene array to a uint8 RGB image with optional user input and solved status
observations_to_float_rgb: convert a simulator scene array to a normalized float RGB image for display or processing
save_observation_series_to_gif: save a batch of observation scene arrays as an animated GIF file to disk
compose_gifs: concatenate and synchronize multiple GIF files into a single side-by-side animated GIF output
compose_gifs_compact: compose a compact GIF showing only the first and last frames of each input GIF file
